news.title: 2026/2027 Academic Session: Admission Now Open for All Arms
news.excerpt: Peculiar College Doma invites parents and guardians to enroll their children into Nursery, Primary, and Secondary classes for the upcoming academic session.
news.content:
We are pleased to announce that admission applications for the 2026/2027 academic session are now officially open across all educational arms: Nursery (Early Years), Primary (Foundational), and Secondary (College).
    
At Peculiar College Doma, we combine qualitative classroom instruction with strong moral foundations, disciplined leadership training, and engaging extracurricular sports. Admission forms are available online through our portal and at the school administration office.

Interested parents are encouraged to apply early as class capacities are strictly managed to maintain optimal student-teacher ratios.
news.author: Admissions Office

news.title: Inter-House Sports Championship: Purple (Faith) House Emerges Overall Champions
news.excerpt: An exciting showcase of athletic talent, sportsmanship, and teamwork culminated in a colorful trophy presentation ceremony at the school grounds.
news.content:
The annual Peculiar College Inter-House Sports competition concluded with breathtaking track and field events and a thrilling volleyball finale.

Students competed vigorously across four traditional houses: Purple (Faith), Orange (Grace), Blue (Peace), and Red (Hope). Purple House carried the day with an impressive tally of gold medals in volleyball, relays, and long jump, clinching the prestigious 2026 Principal Trophy.

The school management commends all participants, staff coordinators, and parents who turned out in large numbers to cheer our young champions.
news.author: Sports Committee

news.title: Resumption Timetable & Continuous Assessment Guidelines Released
news.excerpt: Academic calendar update covering midterm break resumption, project submission dates, and preparations for terminal unified examinations.
news.content:
All students and parents are hereby notified that regular classes have resumed following the scheduled midterm break.

Teachers across Nursery, Primary, and Secondary sections have begun administering the second continuous assessment tests (CA 2). Parents are kindly advised to monitor their children's homework diaries and ensure regular study habits at home.
news.author: Academic Board
